title: Wayfare Pro All Access Discount (Wayfare Pass)
content:
# Wayfare Pro All Access discount

*Wayfare Pass (rider membership), on a move up to Wayfare Pass All Access Annual.*

**Definition.** The Wayfare Pro All Access discount follows the Wayfare Pro status on the member's own driver earnings account: 10 percent at Wayfare Pro Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite, 5 percent at Wayfare Pro Gold or Silver, nothing at Wayfare Pro Blue or without an earnings account.

**Effect.** The discount is taken off the All Access upgrade charge as that percentage of the All Access Annual membership fee of 249.00; the percentage is of the 249.00 fee itself, the amount taken off is not rounded on its own, and the charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Status source.** The member's own earnings account in Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro, on the same customer profile, with the Wayfare Pro status it carries for the quarter.

| Wayfare Pro status | Discount |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 10 percent |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 10 percent |
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | 10 percent |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 5 percent |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 5 percent |
| Wayfare Pro Blue | nothing |
| no earnings account | nothing |

**Examples (hypothetical).** A member whose earnings account shows Wayfare Pro Platinum has 24.90 taken off; one at Wayfare Pro Silver, 12.45; a rider with no earnings account, nothing.
